title: Identifying the sources of ideological bias in GPT models through linguistic variation in output

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 on politically sensitive topics (abortion and Catalan independence) across multiple languages (Swedish, Polish, English, Catalan, and Spanish), manually coding the outputs for specific ideological stances (e.g., pro-choice, anti-independence), and using multilevel modeling to estimate the probability of biased responses based on the input language.
